newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Northeast air quality group to meet May 20.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Northeast air quality group to meet May 20.

text.p: The Ozone Transport Commission said it will meet Tuesday, May 20, in Annapolis, Md., to review air quality needs within the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic States, including reduction of motor vehicle and stationary source air pollution.

The commission is a policy-making group that coordinates regional efforts to reduce ground level ozone air pollution. Members include environmental officials from 12 northeastern and mid-Atlantic States and the District of Columbia.

During Tuesday's meeting at the Governor Calvert House, the commission is also expected to address issues related to the transport of ozone into its region, including progress of the 37-State Ozone Transport Assessment Group.
In addition, the commission staff said, the group is expected to elect its new vice chair.
It said the meeting begins at 0900 EDT and is expected to include a press conference about 1215 EDT/1615 GMT.

The commission is chaired by Robert C. Shinn Jr, Commissioner of the New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection. The present Vice Chair is Christophe A.G. Tulou, Secretary of the Delaware Department of Natural Resources and Environmental Control. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
